decisions.decision: Run forecasts as a scheduled weekly batch
decisions.context: The system produces demand forecasts once per week for each store and product. The brief gives no need for interactive or real-time predictions.

alternatives.label: Scheduled batch pipeline
pros: Fast model iteration: changes fit pipeline stages
cons: Weekly-run reliability: failures can delay the full run

alternatives.label: On-demand prediction service
pros: Fast model iteration: deploy behind a service
cons: Weekly-run reliability: adds always-on service operations
Fast model iteration: requires serving integration

decisions.rationale: Weekly-run reliability decides the choice: a scheduled batch matches the forecast cadence and keeps execution bounded. This gives up on-demand forecasts, which the brief does not require.
consequences: Pipeline must complete within the weekly delivery window.
Model changes must integrate with the batch run.

decisions.decision: Preserve versioned inputs and artifacts for reproducibility
decisions.context: The team must reproduce forecasts for any past week. That requires retaining enough information about the data and model used for each run to recreate its outputs.

alternatives.label: Versioned data, code, configuration, and model artifacts
pros: Forecast reproducibility: records each run's inputs and artifacts
Weekly-run reliability: supports reruns from recorded state
cons: Forecast reproducibility: requires storage and retention practices

alternatives.label: Keep only the latest data and model
cons: Forecast reproducibility: past runs may not be recreated

chosen.label: Versioned data, code, configuration, and model artifacts

decisions.rationale: Forecast reproducibility decides the choice: retaining versioned run inputs and artifacts enables past forecasts to be recreated. This costs storage and additional artifact management.
consequences: Each run must record references to its data, code, configuration, and model.
Retention and artifact storage need ongoing ownership.

decisions.decision: Validate model changes before the weekly production run
decisions.context: New model ideas should reach production quickly without breaking the weekly run. A separate validation step can check candidate changes before they affect production forecasts.

alternatives.label: Validate candidates on historical weeks before promotion
pros: Weekly-run reliability: candidate failures stay out of production
Fast model iteration: supports repeatable candidate evaluation
cons: Fast model iteration: validation adds a promotion step

alternatives.label: Replace the production model directly
pros: Fast model iteration: shortest path to production
cons: Weekly-run reliability: candidate changes can break the run
Forecast reproducibility: unrecorded changes complicate reruns

chosen.label: Validate candidates on historical weeks before promotion

decisions.rationale: Weekly-run reliability decides the choice: candidate models are checked before promotion, reducing the chance that an experiment disrupts production. This gives up some deployment speed for the validation step.
consequences: Historical evaluation data and acceptance criteria must be maintained.
Promoted model versions must be recorded with production runs.
